newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones sees full year EPS $1.20-$1.40.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones sees full year EPS $1.20-$1.40.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co said Wednesday that its $650 million multiyear investment program for Dow Jones Markets, together with the near-term outlook for that unit, will reduce earnings for the year to the previously announced range of $1.20 to $1.40 per share.
Analysts on average are expecting earnings per share of $1.31 for 1997, according to First Call.
The company announced earlier this year its plan to invest in the expansion and revitalization of Dow Jones Markets, its financial information services unit.
Dow Jones earned $0.27 per share in the first quarter of 1997, including a per share gain of $0.04 on the sale its American Demographics subsidiary.
The company's shares were down 3/8 to 40-3/8 in early morning activity.
